TRAINING STEP · VISUAL MODULE MAP

One step: make a prediction, measure the mistake, adjust the network.

Ordinarily one batch leads to one update. With gradient accumulation, several batch iterations can feed a single optimizer step.

questions.technicalExplanation:
Detailed explanation: Original Self-Contained PyTorch One SGD Step nn.Linear(2,1)పై Runs. Seedతో Weights Approximately [0.049,−0.426] నుంచి [0.175,−0.295]కి Move అయ్యాయని Source Reports. Code Below Source నుంచి Unchanged; Result Runtime/Versionపై Depend. PyTorch Optimizer Tutorial.
import torch
from torch import nn

torch.manual_seed(7)
model = nn.Linear(2, 1)
optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.01)
inputs = torch.tensor([[1., 2.], [2., 1.],
                       [3., 4.], [4., 3.]])
targets = torch.tensor([[1.], [1.], [2.], [2.]])
loss_fn = nn.MSELoss()

model.train()
before = model.weight.detach().clone()
optimizer.zero_grad()
predictions = model(inputs)
loss = loss_fn(predictions, targets)
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()
after = model.weight.detach().clone()

print("before:", before.tolist())
print("after :", after.tolist())
print("changed:", not torch.equal(before, after))
